newsitem.title: GERMANY: German DAX higher mid-bourse, just off record highs.
newsitem.headline: German DAX higher mid-bourse, just off record highs.

text.p: 1016 GMT - German shares remain in record territory in mid-session bourse trade on Thursday, boosted by Wall Street's overnight advance and by the stable, if slightly lower, dollar. Dealers said that 4,500 points was a possiblity over the day, DAX future rose to within two points of 4,500 earlier on.
* DAX-30 index at 4,442 points, up 20.28 points or 0.46 pct, having earlier hit an all-time bourse high of 4,459.89.
* Focus on Daimler-Benz, down nearly three pct on profit-taking despite more-than-doubling H1 operating profit.
* Allianz, Vereinsbank, Hypo-Bank lower after outlining merger details.
